description:

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Experience: 5–8 years (minimum 2 years in a branch leadership role)

Industry: Overseas Education / Study Abroad Consulting

Employment Type: Full\-Time

ABOUT THE ROLE

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

We are looking for a high\-ownership Branch Manager to lead our Mumbai office end\-to\-end. This is not a purely administrative role — we need someone who can drive student enrolments, build a high\-performing counselling team, and position our branch as the go\-to overseas education destination in Mumbai. You will report directly to senior leadership and have full accountability for the branch's performance, culture, and growth.

ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

1\. BRANCH OPERATIONS \& P\&L MANAGEMENT

* Own the branch's monthly, quarterly, and annual enrolment targets
* Monitor and manage branch\-level revenue, expenses, and profitability
* Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for leadership
* Ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations including office administration, vendor coordination, and compliance
* Implement SOPs for all branch processes — lead management, counselling, documentation, and visa filing

2\. STUDENT COUNSELLING \& CONVERSION

* Oversee the end\-to\-end student journey from first enquiry to visa approval
* Step in personally on high\-value or complex student cases to guide counsellors
* Drive walk\-in conversion rates by monitoring counsellor performance at every stage of the funnel
* Ensure students receive accurate, ethical, and comprehensive guidance on universities, courses, intakes, scholarships, and visa requirements
* Resolve student escalations and complaints swiftly and professionally
* Stay updated on destination\-specific changes (UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Europe, Ireland, New Zealand) including visa policy, tuition fee changes, and intake patterns

3\. TEAM LEADERSHIP \& PEOPLE MANAGEMENT

* Recruit, onboard, and manage a team of student counsellors, application processors, and front desk staff
* Set individual KPIs and conduct regular one\-on\-ones and performance reviews
* Coach and mentor counsellors to improve their product knowledge, communication skills, and conversion ability
* Identify training needs and coordinate with the central team to deliver upskilling sessions
* Build a positive, target\-driven branch culture with low attrition
* Handle team conflicts, attendance, and HR\-related matters at the branch level

4\. LEAD GENERATION \& BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

* Drive footfall and walk\-ins through local marketing, referral programs, and community engagement
* Build and nurture relationships with schools, junior colleges, degree colleges, coaching centres, and education influencers in Mumbai
* Organise and participate in education fairs, seminars, school visits, and open days
* Coordinate with the digital/marketing team to run local campaigns and follow up on inbound digital leads
* Develop B2B tie\-ups with feeder institutions to create a consistent pipeline of students
* Track competitor activity in Mumbai and share market intelligence with leadership

* Liaise with university representatives and attend university roadshows and training sessions
* Maintain strong relationships with university admission teams to benefit students on borderline applications
* Ensure the branch team is up\-to\-date on partner university programs, entry requirements, and promotions
* Coordinate with university partners for events, webinars, and on\-campus visits

6\. QUALITY \& COMPLIANCE

* Ensure all student files, applications, and documentation meet company and partner university standards
* Monitor the accuracy of applications submitted and minimise rejection rates
* Ensure the branch adheres to all internal compliance guidelines and data protection standards
* Conduct regular audits of student files and counselling notes

7\. REPORTING \& STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

* Submit weekly performance dashboards to the regional/central team
* Participate in monthly business review calls with senior leadership
* Highlight risks, blockers, and resource needs proactively
* Represent the branch's perspective constructively and advocate for your team's needs

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

* Minimum 2 years in a branch leadership or team management role
* Proven record of consistently achieving enrolment targets
* Deep knowledge of at least 3–4 study destinations (UK, USA, Canada, Australia preferred)

* Entrepreneurial mindset — treats the branch like their own business
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi (Marathi is a plus)
* Proficiency in CRM tools, MS Excel, and basic reporting
* Currently based in Mumbai or willing to relocate immediately

WHAT WE OFFER

* A fast\-growing company with a strong support infrastructure

We believe every child deserves an equal opportunity to grow to their fullest potential, regardless of background. Learning should be joyful, unhurried, and rooted in trust — in the child's own curiosity and in the professionalism of the teacher guiding them.
